notes: Incremental stories added for schema/contract, config registration, error contract, and observability.

change_log.value: Add tool schema/contract definitions and registry
Standardized error handling and response contract
Logging and observability for tool routing

stories.title: Tool Schema and Contract Registry
stories.description: Define a centralized registry mapping tool names to their Pydantic schemas and handler functions, establishing a strict contract for all allowed tools used by the router.

stories.title: Allowlist Configuration and Tool Registration
stories.description: Implement a configurable allowlist mechanism that explicitly registers approved tools at application startup, ensuring only declared tools are routable by the system.

stories.title: Standardized Tool Error Handling Contract
stories.description: Define and enforce a consistent error response structure for tool routing failures, including allowlist violations, validation errors, and execution exceptions, ensuring safe and predictable agent behavior.

stories.title: Tool Routing Logging and Observability
stories.description: Integrate debug logging for tool routing decisions, including tool selection, validation outcomes, allowlist checks, and execution timing, enabling traceability and auditability.
